svg.title: Four silent changes between the file and the tensor
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Four silent changes between the file and the tensor” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A JPEG file becoming a NumPy array of shape 240 by 320 by 3 in BGR uint8, then four stacked blue transformation arrows for channel order, axis order, dtype and normalization, each annotated in red with the bug that skipping it produces, ending in a 3 by 224 by 224 float tensor; below, a five-by-five grid of numbers with a red three-by-three kernel window over its corner producing the value 16 in a three-by-three feature map, with the multiply-accumulate written out longhand.
svg.text: Four silent changes between the file and the tensor
draw it from memory, then compare
